Crappy Road Bikes Group Ride

Greenwood Village, CO · Denver Tech Center · Road · Social

Crappy Road Bikes Group Ride is a road and social group ride in Greenwood Village, CO. It rolls every Thursday at 5:15 pm from Illegal Pete's - DTC.

For visitors

Check tires and brakes. Blinking front and rear lights are encouraged. The Meetup post says the start moved back to Illegal Pete's because school is in session.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 16-17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

About the Crappy Road Bikes Group Ride group ride

A party-pace road and gravel-bike ride that says to bring whatever bike you have, old and beat-up preferred. The route is all paved, about 80 percent bike path, and the group averages around 16 to 17 mph. Food after the ride.
